text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
――Hey, how's that going? The report 
assigned in last week's "Race Strategy" 
class.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"The appeal of styles different from your 
own," right? Um... honestly, not really. 
It's quite a difficult topic.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Still, once she decided to write about the 
'Tiara Route,' she's been working hard 
consulting with Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Hearing directly from someone who 
actually races is the best way, after all! 
...What about you, Fukukitaru?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Light O-san, a regular at the omikuji 
fortune-telling, has also been constantly 
pitching straight-line PR to me, so I 
figured I'd compile all of that!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! In that case, I'll go ahead and 
interview Doto lots and lots, too! ……How 
about you, Urv!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh my~? Alve-sama is not at her seat~.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Is your report coming along well?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Air Groove-san. Is something the 
matter?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No, it's just that Suzuka interviewed me 
for that assignment.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that she was struggling, I thought 
you might have hit a roadblock as well—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ! This is……

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Splendid. You didn't just look at the 
racing world in isolation, but analyzed it 
in connection with the historical context 
of the time.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
And look at the sheer amount of 
information here. Just how many people did 
she interview?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I did not. It was compiled entirely from 
library materials.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ! You did all this alone?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I am more than sufficient on my own.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, I apologize for my insolence. It 
seems I underestimated the "prodigy."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If I recall, this report is to be posted 
at a later date. ...I look forward to 
seeing the finished product.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While looking through Admire Groove's 
report, which has recently become a hot 
topic among Trainers...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Alv-sama~ Congratulations on winning first 
prize for your report~ *clap clap*~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's seriously impressive. Even the 
trainers have come out to watch...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Not particularly. It is merely an 
assignment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe~ As expected of Lady Alve. Always 
so cool and beautiful today as well~♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Even the adults are talking about it. 
That's Alve for you. I've gotta step up my 
game too.
